from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Represents one document in the collection, capturing its title and outgoing references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the paper/document")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers from the collection that this paper explicitly references")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
